goal.title: All 17 fields: walk to field + gather + walk home, Natro 1:1
goal.summary: All 17 path-out routes pass 3/3. With Natro's drift check on, the full loop (walk out, gather, walk home, convert) passes 3/3 on 14 of 17 fields. Sunflower is at 2/3 and Dandelion at 1/3 and are being re-tested on the new walk code (#53). Coconut can't be tested because the Coconut Crab kills the alt.

routes_note: Live tests on the laptop on the Natro 1:1 engine with Natro's drift check on (latest runs 11:41 PM and 12:01 AM PT). “Full loop” means walk to the field, gather, walk home, and convert, 3 loops per field. None of these numbers are invented.
